figurative_meaning_en: To forcibly extract or extort against one's will
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাকে তার কাছ থেকে টাকা খিঁচে নিতে হয়েছে।
দোকানদার গ্রাহকের কাছ থেকে অতিরিক্ত দাম খিঁচে নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: I had to squeeze the money out of him against his will.
The shopkeeper extorted extra money from the customer.
note: This idiom evokes the image of physically pinching to extract something, metaphorically applied to unwilling extraction of resources.
